body.name: Three-plan active-allocation elimination handle
body.construction: For each \(\sigma\in\Sigma_3\), enumerate the terminal response tables by strict-cycle tests; reduce every quadratic image to mixtures containing at most one response table from each first-choice class; group the resulting rank-one curves by shared square budgets; solve every nonnegative active-allocation regime jointly; and translate the resulting support conditions and equality cases into a finite Boolean formula together with explicit rank-one decompositions.
